exposure: available sun exposure in the first trimester
available sun exposure in the second trimester
cohort: The study included 556,376 singleton births (from 397,370 mothers) in Scotland between 2000 and 2010, all occurring at or after 24 weeks gestation.
finding: Increased available sun exposure in the first trimester of pregnancy was associated with a reduced risk of preterm birth, with the highest quartile of sun exposure showing an adjusted OR of 0.91 (95% CI 0.87, 0.93) compared to the lowest quartile.
gest_age: Outcome defined as birth at <37 weeks gestation; participants included births at or after 24 weeks gestation.
